bfc-tile: position: relative; overflow: hidden; cursor: zoom-in; padding: 0px; background-color: #1D1A17; grid-row: span 2; min-height: 0px; &:focus { outline-width: 3px; outline-color: #C68D55; outline-style: solid; outline-offset: 3px; }
bfc-tile-img: position: absolute; inset: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
bfc-tile-cat: display: block; margin: 0px; position: absolute; inset-block-start: 0.5rem; inset-inline-start: 0.5rem; padding-block-start: 0.2rem; padding-block-end: 0.2rem; padding-inline-start: 0.45rem; padding-inline-end: 0.45rem; font-family: "DM Mono"; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.64rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; background-color: rgba(13,11,10,0.78); color: #EEE8DF;
bfc-gallery: padding: 0px; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr)); grid-auto-rows: 140px; grid-auto-flow: dense; column-gap: 6px; row-gap: 6px; background-color: #3A332C; border-width: 6px; border-style: solid; border-color: #3A332C; @media(--tablet) { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); } @media(--mobile) { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); grid-auto-rows: 110px; }
